controls.title: Entitlement and population map
controls.assertion: Every planned access feature is mapped to its required entitlement and the affected licensed population.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Subscription/service-plan inventory and feature-by-population review.
controls.review_gate: Conditional Access requires Entra P1; risk-based policies require P2. Verify adjunct product entitlements separately.

controls.title: Continuous baseline protection
controls.assertion: The tenant uses reviewed security defaults or an effective replacement Conditional Access set, with no unprotected transition.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Chosen mode, effective policy coverage, MFA and legacy-client tests.
controls.review_gate: Security defaults are not individually customizable and are not combined with Conditional Access.

controls.title: Phishing-resistant privileged access
controls.assertion: In-scope privileged users are required to use the approved phishing-resistant authentication strength and can complete it.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Authentication-strength policy, assignments, registered methods, and pilot sign-ins.
controls.review_gate: Requires appropriate Conditional Access licensing; enrollment alone does not prove enforcement.

controls.title: Emergency access
controls.assertion: Two or more cloud-only emergency accounts have phishing-resistant credentials, monitored use, and tested access independent of normal federation.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Private exercise record, permanent active role review, secure credential custody, and alert test.
controls.review_gate: Exclude emergency accounts from blocking/restrictive Conditional Access; do not remove their authentication protection.

controls.title: Least privilege and accountable admins
controls.assertion: Routine administration uses separate identifiable accounts with only required roles and periodic access review.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Privileged assignment roster and a task-to-role review.
controls.review_gate: Use the smallest workable role; assess any PIM licensing and recovery implications before changing assignments.

controls.title: Legacy authentication control
controls.assertion: Legacy user authentication is blocked with any remaining dependency explicitly recorded and remediated.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Sign-in evidence by client type, effective policy, and approved dependency/exception list.
controls.review_gate: Inventory service and device dependencies first; user policies do not govern all workload identities.

controls.title: Tested compliant-device access
controls.assertion: Selected sensitive workloads enforce reviewed device compliance after enrollment and platform tests pass.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Intune policy/assignment evidence, compliant and noncompliant device tests, effective access policy.
controls.review_gate: Create compliance policy first; requiring compliance without validated coverage can interrupt access.

controls.title: No unassigned compliant devices
controls.assertion: For the selected Intune compliance design, devices with no compliance policy assigned are treated as not compliant.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Tenant compliance setting and assignment-coverage report.
controls.review_gate: Verify policy assignments and grace behavior before changing this tenant-wide setting.

controls.title: Authenticated sharing for sensitive content
controls.assertion: Sensitive sites and OneDrives avoid Anyone links and use an approved authenticated sharing level and default link type.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Organization/site settings and synthetic internal/external sharing tests.
controls.review_gate: Review Teams, Groups, Entra B2B and site settings together; file-request workflows may depend on Anyone links.

controls.title: Guest ownership and expiry
controls.assertion: External access has a sponsor, an end/review date, and a tested revocation process across sites, groups and apps.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Guest review decisions, effective expiry behavior, and resource-level removal test.
controls.review_gate: Native access-review capabilities have license requirements; a documented manual review can meet this process objective.

controls.title: Controlled user consent
controls.assertion: User consent is restricted by a reviewed policy with an explicit approval route for requests outside it.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Effective consent policy, reviewer ownership, and synthetic blocked/approved request tests.
controls.review_gate: Review the actual permission grant; verified publisher status alone is not risk acceptance.

controls.title: Application permission ownership
controls.assertion: Enterprise application permissions have an accountable owner, minimum justified access, and a current recertification decision.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Service-principal permissions and owner inventory, delegated/application permission review.
controls.review_gate: Review application permissions separately from user access assignments; changing consent can interrupt jobs.

controls.title: SPF sender inventory
controls.assertion: Each sending domain has a validated SPF record covering all authorized senders without duplicate SPF records or invalid lookup expansion.
controls.evidence_to_collect: DNS record, sender inventory and representative message-header tests.
controls.review_gate: DNS is managed at the domain host; record all non-Microsoft senders before changing it.

controls.title: Custom-domain DKIM
controls.assertion: Each in-scope custom sending domain has enabled, validated DKIM signing using the tenant-provided selector values.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Actual selector CNAME values, signing status, and received-message verification.
controls.review_gate: Microsoft selector formats can vary; obtain actual values rather than synthesizing them.

controls.title: DMARC enforcement plan
controls.assertion: A domain owner has validated alignment and reporting, completed sender remediation, and approved an enforced DMARC policy.
controls.evidence_to_collect: DMARC policy, sender alignment tests, report review and staged rollout record.
controls.review_gate: Do not jump to rejection while legitimate senders remain unverified.

controls.title: Entra logs retrievable for the need
controls.assertion: Identity log sources, native windows, archive needs, access owners, and retrieval tests match the approved investigation requirement.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Source/retention matrix plus a retrieved synthetic sign-in or admin event.
controls.review_gate: Entra and Purview audit retention are separate; an upgrade cannot recover expired logs.

controls.title: Purview audit coverage
controls.assertion: Required Microsoft 365 audit activities are searchable and retained for the approved need with verified user licensing and scope.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Audit search result, workload coverage, retention settings and applicable licenses.
controls.review_gate: Standard and Premium capabilities differ; do not assume one tenant license covers every user or event.

controls.title: Approved records lifecycle
controls.assertion: Retention and deletion settings match an approved records schedule, with holds and affected workloads checked before rollout.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Records schedule, effective policies/labels and review of preservation/deletion impacts.
controls.review_gate: Retention is a records decision; do not assign a universal duration or treat it as a backup.

controls.title: Measured recovery coverage
controls.assertion: Critical workloads have an approved recovery method, recovery objectives, protected scope, and a measured restore exercise.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Recovery coverage matrix and restore results for content, ownership and permissions.
controls.review_gate: Microsoft 365 Backup is a separate consumption-billed option; verify actual protected units and recovery behavior.

controls.title: Staged access changes
controls.assertion: Access changes have documented scope, exclusions, report-only/pilot evidence, business tests and a tested rollback route.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Change plan, representative sign-in tests and independent verifier record.
controls.review_gate: Do not disable security defaults until replacement protection is ready; verify recovery before enforcement.
